subject.title: model-selection: duplicate model aliases silently overwrite each other

question: Should duplicate model aliases preserve the shipped last-match selected provider/model while warning, or may OpenClaw intentionally switch duplicate aliases to first-match selection?
rationale: The warning is straightforward, but changing which duplicate alias wins is a compatibility and auth-provider routing decision for existing configs.

options.title: Preserve Shipped Winner While Warning
options.body: Keep the currently selected last matching provider/model, add warnings, and cover the alias-index path too.

options.title: Approve First-Match Precedence
options.body: Accept the reroute risk with explicit upgrade proof and release-note context for existing duplicate-alias configs.

options.title: Pause For Unified Replacement
options.body: Use one canonical PR to cover both resolver paths if maintainers do not want to repair either open branch.

recommendation.title: Preserve Shipped Winner While Warning
recommendation.body: Keep the currently selected last matching provider/model, add warnings, and cover the alias-index path too.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest feature-history signal across the shared model-selection helper, provider alias behavior, and docs.
